about: Landgrab's proxy host in Nginx Proxy Manager on the NAS (docs/deployment-nas.md). scripts/nas/proxy-host.py sync makes NPM match this file. Field names are NPM's own. Only names under allowed_suffixes can be changed, never Time for Guests or identity.unitytech.nl.

hosts.note: Web app, /api and the SignalR hub /hub/game (WebSockets) through the landgrab frontend container's nginx.
